notes: Cited line opened: tf2/include/tf2/buffer_core.h:306 matches the provenance description. The method fills std::vector<std::string>& output with frame names (the chain between source and target); it carries no spatial data and has no frame of its own, which supports frame=none. Caveat for downstream use: the API does handle frame-name strings as its payload, so 'none' means 'no coordinate frame of the element', not 'no frame identifiers involved'.
